column6: eval (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table.wikitable tbody tr'); for (const row of rows) { const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); const text = row.textContent.toLowerCase(); if (text.includes('tungsten')) { return { cells: Array.from(cells).map(c => c.textContent.trim()), raw: row.textContent.trim().substring(0, 300) }; } } return 'not found'; })()
